XIAO_TU_RELIC_RUSTY_MEMORIAL_DICE.title: Rusty Memorial Die
XIAO_TU_RELIC_RUSTY_MEMORIAL_DICE.descri: At the start of combat, gain 1 die. Reroll all dice at the start of each turn. Your gold can go negative (down to -1000); each gold below 0 increases attack damage you take by 0.5%.
XIAO_TU_RELIC_RUSTY_MEMORIAL_DICE.flavor: They put it in her hand at the funeral. The rust tastes of sea water.
XIAO_TU_RELIC_LEGENDARY_DIE.title: Legendary Die
XIAO_TU_RELIC_LEGENDARY_DIE.description: At the start of combat, gain 1 additional die (2 total).
XIAO_TU_RELIC_SHOP_DIE.title: Merchant's Die
XIAO_TU_RELIC_SHOP_DIE.description: At the start of combat, gain 1 additional die.
XIAO_TU_RELIC_SLOT_MACHINE.title: Slot Machine
XIAO_TU_RELIC_SLOT_MACHINE.description: Every 7 dice rerolls, draw 1 card. (Counter persists between combats.)
XIAO_TU_RELIC_MEMBERSHIP_CARD.title: Membership Card
XIAO_TU_RELIC_MEMBERSHIP_CARD.descriptio: Every 5 times you gain a die, gain 1 Energy. (Counter persists between combats.)
XIAO_TU_RELIC_TAINTED_CHURCH_COIN.title: Tainted Church Coin
XIAO_TU_RELIC_TAINTED_CHURCH_COIN.descri: Upon pickup, gain 500 gold and add a Debt to your deck.
